scope: Formal conditioning ablation design for execution inside the native NVIDIA CorrDiff environment.
invariants_held_fixed_across_ablations: same Phase 15 split indices and temporal purge
same patch geometry and target definition
same NVIDIA CorrDiff regression architecture within each ablation stage
same NVIDIA CorrDiff diffusion architecture within each confirmation stage
same optimizer family, learning-rate schedule, batch-size policy and training budget
same random seed set within a comparison stage
same normalization policy: fit separately on train for channels present in that experiment
same validation timestamps and natural event prevalence
no access to 2023/2024 for model or channel selection

derived_channel_policy.compute_from: raw ERA5 channels inside or immediately before the native NVIDIA CorrDiff data pipeline
derived_channel_policy.normalization: each derived channel receives train-only mean/std fitted after derivation

stage_R_regression_screen.purpose: Screen all conditioning configurations using the native CorrDiff regression model.

stage_D_corrdiff_confirmation.purpose: Confirm conditioning effects in the generative CorrDiff stage after regression screening.
stage_D_corrdiff_confirmation.selection_rule_for_optional_runs: Optional runs are permitted only according to a predeclared compute budget. If not all optional runs can be executed, prioritize the single-family or derived-family contrasts needed to resolve an ambiguity observed in Stage R; document the choice before training.

family_necessity.meaning: incremental contribution associated with thermal predictors
incremental contribution associated with moisture predictors

derived_representation.meaning: effect of adding all deterministic derived representations

corrdiff_ensemble_metrics_to_enable_when: Brier score for P(pixel >= threshold) at 20/30/40/45 dBZ
CRPS or equivalent ensemble distribution score supported by the NVIDIA evaluation stack
ensemble FSS or FSS of exceedance-probability/ensemble-mean products, with definition frozen before test
validation_metrics.selection_principle: Do not collapse all metrics to a single scalar. Use a Pareto/hierarchical reading: first spatial/event skill (FSS/CSI at >=30 and >=40), then event-conditioned maximum-intensity error, then global RMSE/MAE. >=45 is a critical secondary extreme diagnostic due to rarity.

hypotheses_to_test_not_assume: Moisture-only conditioning may retain more moderate-event occurrence skill than other single families.
Thermal conditioning may contribute relatively more at the highest thresholds than at moderate thresholds.
Dynamics may add little scalar pixelwise association yet still help spatial organization.
Derived variables may improve representation/optimization without adding information beyond raw12.
Removing one family can reveal conditional value hidden by multicollinearity in the full predictor set.
reporting_rules: Report all three seeds for every executed configuration; summarize median and spread, never only the best seed.
Keep regression-stage and CorrDiff-stage conclusions separate.
Do not claim causality from ablation performance differences.
Do not interpret deterministic derived channels as independent physical information.
Do not inspect 2023 or 2024 until Phase 17/18 design and hyperparameters are frozen.
